rationale: Consequential development-governance contract; independent architect/challenge required before changes to finite enforcement. New independent governance ticket, not reset of Issue83 product attempts.

authorization.name: burha
authorization.evidence: Chat01a1031a-7a25-77d0-90d6-c9839f8d0803 on2026-10-04: that limit should not be about completion time but about how many times we hop around review-design reset-reimplement cycle. Authorizes cycle-only governance correction, preserving attempts and history; not an Issue83 attempt extension.

scope.S84: Replace completion/elapsed-time exhaustion with finite review/design-reset/reimplementation cycle caps; update workflow engine, tests, templates, instructions and docs; backwards-compatible append-only historical migration and split attempt conservation.

non_goals: Authentication or other application code/graph/financial contracts
Resetting consumed attempts or rewriting existing histories
Product verification claims for blocked Issue83

invariants.I84CYCLES: Default one implementation/initial-review/remediation/final-review/design-reset lifetime attempt persists across agents/sessions/quota resets/design resets. Extra attempts require explicit named user authorization.
invariants.I84TIME: Completion time/quota waits/open-phase elapsed time never gate new cycle-only work or require minute extensions. Timing may remain historical/audit data.
invariants.I84HISTORY: Existing ledger prefixes/capsules/counters/content/PR bindings remain immutable and validated; explicit policy transition cannot clear attempts, review outcomes or substantive blockers.
invariants.I84GATES: Consequential design/challenge/approval, role ownership, review independence, content-bound acceptance/verification/review and clean delivery remain enforced.
invariants.I84SPLIT: Successor/sibling allocation conserves remaining attempt allowances and inherits consumed history; split/new issue cannot silently replenish attempts.
invariants.I84ISOLATE: Only development-governance engine/docs/tests change; current Issue83 product work preserved.

interfaces: Workflow CLI/status/append and ledger policy/transition JSON
Split-lineage allocation and explicit cycle extensions
json_state_impact: Workflow-only ledger policy/allocation/transition fields or events as architect specifies, backwards-compatible immutable old events. Application graph/checkpoint JSON: none.

acceptance.AC84TIME: New cycle-only ledgers and explicitly transitioned expired/suspended legacy ledgers can resume after arbitrary waits without timing extensions; status explains remaining attempts rather than misleading minute debt.
acceptance.AC84CYCLES: Counted phase limits/failed-final-review stop still enforce across resets/handoffs/quota waits; explicit count extension cannot be replayed or impersonated.
acceptance.AC84HISTORY: Historical delivered/split/bootstrap ledgers replay without rewriting; transitions preserve prefix/capsule/counts/bindings and deny clearing substantive blockers or converting delivered tickets.
acceptance.AC84SPLIT: Split successors/siblings inherit consumed counts and validated allocated remaining allowances, cannot multiply attempts or reuse allocations; terminal predecessors remain retired.
acceptance.AC84GATES: Existing ownership/design/challenge/approval/content-bound acceptance/review/verification/PR gates and unrelated static workflow checks remain correct.
acceptance.AC84DOCS: AGENTS/CONTRIBUTING/README/templates/role bodies explain cycle-only policy; new ADR supersedes timing only; finite-workflow history remains untouched.
acceptance.AC84VERIFY: Focused engine/CLI/negative fixtures plus required offline/static/evaluation/build/Compose gates pass; independent review required; no services/product behavior changes.

verification: Focused ticket_workflow replay/CLI/CI-binding tests including long wait, expired suspended legacy, failed final review, split siblings and substantive blockers
Static validator fixtures; Ruff lint/format; strict mypy; full offline pytest; evaluations; package build; Compose config and diff checks
Independent code review against immutable invariant/AC IDs
documentation: New ADR0030 (0029 reserved for pending auth83) timing supersession only
risks: Time-only blocker handling must not authorize unsafe delivery
Policy changes must not reset frozen contracts or review slots
escalation_triggers: Unresolved allocation/legacy policy ambiguity returns to architect
Concrete replay/compatibility complexity or repeated unresolved failures requires evidence-backed specialist session
Cycle exhaustion or failed final review stops for user decision
